title: Sigmoid Attention as a Better Substrate for Learned KV Cache Eviction
abstract: arXiv:2608.23296v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned KV-cache eviction often faces a soft-to-hard mismatch: during training, differentiable gates typically attenuate token contributions, whereas inference saves memory only when KV entries are physically removed. We ask whether the attention substrate affects this soft-to-hard transition. Using GPT-2-scale Transformers trained on OpenWebText, we run a controlled $2\times2\times2$ comparison over attention type, learned gating, and positional encoding. Although sigmoid attention is worse as a dense language model, learned hard eviction changes the useful operating points: sigmoid-gated models delete KV entries with negligible PPL change relative to their own no-eviction references. Under a matched live-cache protocol on the same dense backbones, learned sigmoid gates obtain lower PPL than our H$_2$O and KeyDiff implementations, whereas softmax gates do not uniformly beat these post-hoc methods. translated_title: Sigmoid注意力机制作为学习型KV缓存驱逐的更好基础
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23296v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：学习型KV缓存驱逐常常面临从软到硬的失配问题：在训练期间，可微分门控通常削弱标记贡献，而推理时只有当KV条目被物理移除时才能节省内存。我们探讨注意力基础是否影响这种软到硬的转变。使用在OpenWebText上训练的GPT-2规模Transformer，我们对注意力类型、学习门控和位置编码进行了受控的2×2×2比较。尽管sigmoid注意力作为密集语言模型表现较差，但学习型硬驱逐改变了有效操作点：sigmoid门控模型删除KV条目时，相对于其自身的无驱逐参考，困惑度变化可忽略不计。在相同密集骨干网络上的匹配活动缓存协议下，学习型sigmoid门控在困惑度上优于我们实现的H₂O和KeyDiff方法，而softmax门控并未一致地超越这些事后方法。结果表明，注意力机制本身影响了学习型KV驱逐的有效性。
tldr: 本文发现sigmoid注意力机制比softmax更适合作为学习型KV缓存驱逐的基础，因为sigmoid门控在硬驱逐时能保持更低的困惑度，优于现有事后方法。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that sigmoid attention is a better substrate than softmax for learned KV cache eviction, as sigmoid gates maintain lower perplexity under hard eviction, outperforming existing post-hoc methods.
